title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10816)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard describes the methods of sampling at manufacturing site and also from bags, wagons, trucks barges or ships of a consignment of zinc/lead concentrates for estimating zinc/lead and moisture content. ♦Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ). 3 IS : 10816 - 1984

clause_2_normative_references.title: Recommendations for modular co-ordination : basic module and submodular increments (Equivalent to ISO 1006 and ISO 6514 : 1982)

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
